validation: Authored source scenarios only. No product imports, execution or tests run.
scope: Conservative receipt classification and existing group-ledger publication ordering; not a new reconciliation or retry engine.

cases.scenario: Invalid captured document or payload before a mutation
cases.expect: Known refusal when graph and operation-owned state have not changed.

cases.scenario: Graph publication succeeds, then doc_state or frame emission fails
cases.expect: Outcome unknown, never a confirmed refusal; no automatic reapply.

cases.scenario: Handler succeeds, then document history recording fails
cases.expect: Keep original receipt fencing and report outcome unknown.

cases.scenario: Publication rolls back while monotonic fences advance
cases.expect: Conservatively unknown; never infer an unchanged fence or rewind it.

cases.scenario: Cursor/reanalysis state changes before a later failure
cases.expect: Outcome unknown, even if graph fence did not move.
Emit correlated unknown result instead of dropping the terminal event.
No graph published; reserved sequence gaps are allowed.

cases.scenario: Shared dirty notification fails after publication
cases.expect: Protected group ledger and shared-mutation marker are retained; no duplicate document-only history.
Original correlated result, no duplicate application.

remaining: Unknown outcomes require inspection/reconciliation; this change does not claim automated reconciliation, clean rollback, compilation or runtime acceptance.
